grade3_ela_proficient.label: Third graders proficient or above in English language arts (state test)
grade3_ela_proficient.source: Georgia Governor's Office of Student Achievement (GOSA), Georgia Milestones End-of-Grade results; NCES Common Core of Data for school system counties
grade3_ela_proficient.note: Share of tested third graders who scored Proficient or Distinguished on the Georgia Milestones English language arts test. County figures combine the county school system, any city school systems in the county and in-person state charter schools, weighted by the number of students tested; virtual state charter schools and systems too small for GOSA to report are left out. Fewer students tested in 2020-2021. The Georgia figure is built the same way from the same systems so counties compare on equal terms; GOSA's own statewide figure, which counts every school, was 35.1% in 2024-2025. In 2024-2025, 7 counties tested fewer than 30 third graders, so their figures can swing a lot from year to year.
